claim: "Favicon URL" is a site setting the user fills in on this screen, shown holding /assets/favicon.ico.
truth: This is the sharpest persistence hole in the module: the favicon typed here never reaches the Site.favicon column that the rest of the product reads. The server accepts a favicon field and the site-health score is computed from that column, so a user can fill this field, save successfully, and the dashboard still scores the site 0 for favicon.
evidence: Written: SiteSettingsScreen.tsx:96-100 flushes `seo: { ...current.seo, favicon: s.favicon, … }` into composer state. Mirrored: BuildrikSyncProvider.ts:140-150 `interface SiteColumnSettings` lists metaTitle/metaDescription/metaTitleTemplate/ogImage/headCode/bodyCode/socialLinks/publishedPassword/touchIcon — no favicon; `extractSiteColumnPatch` :174-197 never sets patch.favicon; `mergeSiteColumnsIntoSettings` :205-232 never reads it. Server side it exists: packages/shared/schemas/site-detail.ts:73 `favicon: z.string().nullable().optional()`, selected at server/services/site-settings.service.ts:76, and consumed at server/services/site-detail.service.ts:112 `const faviconScore = site.favicon || site.touchIcon ? 100 : 0;` which is 20% of healthScore (:113).
